# Mosaic

> > Mosaic is an integrated nonprofit healthcare system serving Central Oregon with comprehensive medical, dental, behavioral health, and pharmacy services across multiple locations.

Mosaic provides accessible, team-based healthcare to communities in Bend, Madras, Prineville, and Redmond. The organization operates as a nonprofit with a mission-driven approach to patient care and community health.

## Key Topics

- Integrated Healthcare
- Nonprofit Healthcare System
- Patient Portal (MyChart)
- Central Oregon Communities
- Team-Based Care Model
- Community Health
- Provider Directory
- Appointment Scheduling

## Getting Started

- [Mosaic Homepage](https://mosaicch.org): Mosaic homepage introducing integrated healthcare services in Central Oregon.
- [Find a Location](https://mosaicch.org/locations): Locate Mosaic healthcare facilities in Bend, Madras, Prineville, and Redmond.
- [Health Services for All Ages](https://mosaicch.org/services): Overview of Mosaic's comprehensive health services for all ages and life stages.
- [Make an Appointment](https://mosaicch.org/appointments): Online appointment scheduling and booking information for Mosaic.

## Patient Resources & Support

- [Current & Future Patient Information](https://mosaicch.org/patient-information): Central hub for patient resources and healthcare information at Mosaic.
- [MyChart Patient Portal FAQ](https://mosaicch.org/patient-information/mychart-faqs): FAQs for MyChart patient portal account setup and management.
- [Pay Bill](https://mosaicch.org/patient-information/pay-bill): Payment options and billing information for Mosaic patients.
- [Contact Us](https://mosaicch.org/contact): Contact information and communication channels for Mosaic.

## Providers & Services

- [Meet Our Providers](https://mosaicch.org/providers): Directory of Mosaic healthcare providers across medical, dental, behavioral health, pharmacy services.

- [About](https://mosaicch.org/about): About Mosaic's mission, founding, and commitment to accessible healthcare.
- [Our Approach to Care](https://mosaicch.org/about/our-approach-to-care): Mosaic's team-based care model and approach to patient health.
- [How We Fund Our Care](https://mosaicch.org/about/how-we-fund-our-care): Nonprofit funding model and financial structure of Mosaic.
- [Community Impact](https://mosaicch.org/about/community-impact): Mosaic's community impact metrics, outcomes, and social mission results.
- [Board of Directors and Leadership](https://mosaicch.org/about/leadership): Board of directors and leadership team information for Mosaic.

- [Health Resources](https://mosaicch.org/health-resources): Health resources, community classes, events, and wellness information.
